CORE-01.kft: Three innate psychological needs (competence, autonomy, relatedness) are the nutriments of intrinsic motivation and internalization; OIT continuum from external regulation to integrated regulation; CET specifies conditions that facilitate/undermine intrinsic motivation; autonomy is explicitly NOT independence/individualism; needs theorized as universal but socioculturally shaped. (Durability of effects is theorized, not demonstrated in-article.)
CORE-01.ess: not_quantifiable (framework article). Strength = high as foundational construct (an importance claim, not an effect size); the quantitative anchor for this row's empirical claims lives in CORE-05.
CORE-01.lim: 2000 overview article (2017 Guilford book is the fuller statement but not legally open in full); three-need postulate is organismic-theoretical and 'inductively identified' within the SDT program, not independently proven in-article; universality claim asserted with cross-cultural support cited but not demonstrated here (cross-cultural evidence thin in 2000); need satisfaction not operationalized; causal language theoretical.
CORE-01.di: Three needs were not demonstrated durable in this article (self-motivation and well-being claims are theoretical).
CORE-01.dimpl: Ground the need-support profile (M2): competence (optimal challenge, effectance-promoting feedback), autonomy (choice, volition, meaningful rationale, freedom from demeaning evaluation), relatedness (secure connection) as three distinguishable supports; relative autonomy is the operative distinction, not intrinsic vs extrinsic. M2 is a design heuristic, not a validated manipulation.
CORE-01.cimpl: Motivation quality is the substrate of moral authorship (S1 telic) - Tier-P; autonomy must be operationalized as volition-within-context to guard against Western-individualist import (design constraint, not achieved property); consistency with Hui's pluralism is a working hypothesis that must absorb the tension between SDT's needs-universality claim and Hui's rejection of universal technics (cf. Limitations) before it can be asserted.

CORE-02.kft: MI and SDT share the assumption of an innate human tendency toward growth and psychological integration; MI provides the social-environmental facilitating factors SDT specifies (autonomy support, competence, relatedness) for promoting this tendency; SDT offers a coherent theoretical framework for MI's processes and efficacy; MI is an autonomy-supportive but 'intentionally directive' clinical method (non-persuasive in style) whose effects can be understood through internalization.
CORE-02.ess: not_quantifiable (theoretical framework proposal; no ES in the paper).
CORE-02.lim: Theoretical synthesis, not empirical test; parallels drawn, causal pathways proposed but not demonstrated here; MI's efficacy is cited from elsewhere and that evidence base carries methodological problems acknowledged in the paper itself ('reasonably consistent and robust effects... despite methodological problems in many of the studies'); no controlled data in this article; the SDT-MI fit remains to be tested.
CORE-02.di: If MI's efficacy does not operate through need-support/internalization pathways, the SDT framing misdescribes the mechanism; if brief interventions change behavior without autonomy support, the social-environmental account is incomplete; MI outcomes may partly reflect non-SDT mechanisms (alliance, expectancy); MI's directiveness means 'non-coercive' must be read as style, not telos.
CORE-02.dimpl: Autonomy-preserving conversational method for ambivalence (Self-Nudging Design Card): MI-style reflective listening, empathy, development of discrepancy, rolling with resistance, supporting self-efficacy; the card must not promise pure non-directiveness - the change goal is co-constructed in method, but its telos remains the person's own (per Ethics Auditor alignment); style is non-persuasive.
CORE-02.cimpl: Candidate technics of listening: MI's non-coercive grammar instantiates the moral dimension of the cosmos-ethic-technics unity at the interpersonal scale, under the condition that the change's telos (not only its means) is defined by the person - otherwise compliance engineering with a gentle grammar; cosmological condition underdetermined (Tier-P, medium Cosmo Rel.).

CORE-04.kft: Self-efficacy beliefs (domain-specific judgments of capability) are the most central mechanism of human agency; four principal sources - enactive mastery experience (strongest), vicarious experience, verbal/social persuasion, physiological/affective states; efficacy beliefs influence choice, effort, persistence, thought patterns, and emotional states; reciprocal determinism between efficacy and performance; efficacy is domain-specific, not a global trait. [CHARTED VIA 1994 COMPANION CHAPTER: row cites the 1997 book (archive-lending-only); charting text is Bandura 1994, 'Self-efficacy', Encyclopedia of Human Behavior 4:71-81 (open, albertbandura.com) - the author's own concise statement of the same theory. Claims about the 1997 book's unique content are not supported by the charted text.]
CORE-04.ess: not_quantifiable from charted source: the 1994 chapter contains no pooled ES (qualitative theoretical synthesis). Earlier draft's Stajkovic & Luthans 1998 reference is an ANACHRONISM (postdates book and chapter) and is not marshaled by either source - removed.
CORE-04.lim: Self-report measurement dominates; causal direction is reciprocal (efficacy <-> performance), not unidirectional; domain-specificity limits global assessment; misjudged efficacy (overconfidence) can be harmful; chapter-level charting cannot speak to the 1997 book's evidence review (collective efficacy, self-regulation, applications); provenance caveat as above.
CORE-04.di: If efficacy beliefs are largely epiphenomenal reflections of prior performance, the causal claim weakens; efficacy-performance correlations may reflect common method variance or ability confounds; interventions that raise efficacy without performance gains indicate boundary conditions; overconfidence cuts against 'more efficacy is better'.
CORE-04.dimpl: Build efficacy via early mastery, not exhortation (M2): graded success experiences, modeling, credible persuasive feedback, physiological-state interpretation; efficacy measure must be task-specific and causal direction must stay reciprocal (raise-efficacy = raise-performance unidirectionally is explicitly denied by the source).
CORE-04.cimpl: Efficacy beliefs are the felt capacity for agency within a milieu; they enter the cosmotechnic frame only via the milieu-mediation argument (technical environments cultivate or corrode felt capacity), and 'good action' must mean action in accordance with the person's affirmed order of value - not moral capacity per se (Bandura's construct is capability judgment); Tier-P.

CORE-05.kft: Meta-analysis of 128 studies: engagement-contingent (d = -0.40), completion-contingent (d = -0.36), and performance-contingent (d = -0.28) rewards significantly undermined free-choice intrinsic motivation; all rewards, all tangible rewards, and all expected rewards also undermined free-choice; engagement- and completion-contingent rewards undermined self-reported interest (d = -0.15, -0.17); positive feedback enhanced free-choice behavior (d = 0.33) and self-reported interest (d = 0.31); tangible rewards more detrimental for children than college students; verbal rewards less enhancing for children.
CORE-05.ess: Supported: all six d-values match the abstract verbatim. Free-choice: d = -0.40 (engagement-contingent), -0.36 (completion-contingent), -0.28 (performance-contingent); self-reported interest: d = -0.15, -0.17; positive feedback: d = +0.33 (free-choice), +0.31 (self-report). Characterized as small-to-medium negative effects; headline pooled estimates - analysis-variant (weighted/unweighted, fixed/random) sensitivity should be checked before any single number is published; estimates contested (Cameron & Pierce 1994; Eisenberger & Cameron 1996).
CORE-05.lim: Meta-analytic heterogeneity; lab free-choice persistence paradigm (observed post-session behavior) - not field/digital engagement; free-choice vs self-report measures capture different outcomes; task-type, reward-type, expectation, and age moderators; mostly Western/educational samples; single-subject studies without no-reward controls excluded (appendix); dissertations partially excluded; sensitivity (weighted vs unweighted, fixed vs random) and publication-bias discussion absent; the paper explicitly reviews 4 previous meta-analyses with divergent results, so estimates are contested; construct validity of the free-choice DV is itself part of the controversy.
CORE-05.di: Undermining applies to activities with initial intrinsic interest (CET boundary); unexpected vs expected rewards differ (expectation matters); if field settings show weaker crowding than lab free-choice measures, external validity is limited; divergent prior meta-analyses mean the true effect size is debated; rewards for uninteresting tasks do not undermine.
CORE-05.dimpl: Sets c_C (crowding coefficient) in the model - Motivation Crowding Watch Card: c_C must be imported as a DIRECTION + bounded band (|d| approx 0.15-0.40), never a point estimate; the pilot must re-estimate its own c_C with a baseline/no-reward contrast (lab free-choice persistence is NOT product engagement - define the pilot DV explicitly); code reward expectation (expected vs unexpected) and task-interest boundary conditions; avoid contingent tangible rewards for intrinsically motivated activity; prefer autonomy-supportive feedback.
CORE-05.cimpl: Contingent reward is a technics that re-orders the person's relation to the act. Where it converts authorship into compliance it instantiates a rupture of the cosmos-ethic-technics unity - a cosmotechnic failure only under the stated criterion (a technical intervention eroding the moral order the person affirms), Tier-P; the meta-analytic data alone do not license the verdict; boundary conditions (initial intrinsic interest, expectation, task type) apply.
CORE-05.cs: causal (lab-bounded: causality established for the free-choice lab paradigm, not for field/digital settings)

CORE-06.kft: External interventions via monetary incentives or punishments may undermine ('crowd out') intrinsic motivation, and under identifiable conditions strengthen ('crowd in') it; crowding is contingent on whether the intervention is perceived as controlling vs acknowledging; the paper argues empirical relevance via circumstantial evidence, laboratory studies, and field/econometric cases (e.g., blood donation, Gneezy & Rustichini fine experiments), claiming crowding 'can, in specific cases, even dominate the traditional relative price effect'.
CORE-06.ess: not_quantifiable: narrative review with no pooled ES; direction-only evidence from selected cases; cannot supply c_C magnitude.
CORE-06.lim: Narrative, non-systematic review (no search protocol, no pooling); 'circumstantial evidence' is the authors' own characterization; heterogeneous studies across countries/periods; senior author is the theory's originator (self-citation circularity: framework cited to Frey 1997a) - advocacy consideration; the paper itself concedes the strongest skeptic position (Prendergast 1999: 'little conclusive empirical evidence, particularly in workplace settings'); flagship cases (blood donation) contested in later literature; crowd-in conditions less studied.
CORE-06.di: If extrinsic incentives do not reliably undermine intrinsic motivation outside the lab (cf. CORE-05/Cameron-Pierce divergence), crowding-out may be context-limited; standard economic predictions (incentives work) hold in many markets - crowding needs identifiable conditions; if perceived-control is the operative variable, the phenomenon may be a mediation effect rather than a distinct crowding process; the review shares much of the same underlying psychological literature as CORE-05, so it is NOT independent confirmation (double-counting risk).
CORE-06.dimpl: Cross-disciplinary CORROBORATION of crowding risk (not confirmation - narrative review) - Motivation Crowding Watch Card; treat incentive addition as a morally and motivationally consequential act; code crowd-IN conditions (acknowledging/non-controlling interventions) in the pilot to avoid confirmation bias toward crowding-out; monitor for crowding-out signals with a no-reward baseline.
CORE-06.cimpl: Incentive design is morally consequential: economic instruments are technics (HUI-2024: the political-technical are not separate spheres); a payment that converts a freely affirmed act into a priced one re-orders the person's relation to the act. 'Motivational order' (the person's micro-order of value and relation to activity) is the operative term - not a decorative 'cosmos'.
CORE-06.cs: correlational (narrative review; cited lab experiments are causal, the synthesis is not)

CORE-08.kft: Nudges can often be turned into self-nudges: empowering interventions that enable people to design and structure their own decision environments - to act as citizen choice architects; self-nudging applies behavioral insights without paternalism/manipulation concerns (by construction in the article); expands behavioral insights from the public to the personal sphere; tools include designing one's proximate choice architecture (defaults, repositioning, notifications, friction), education about self-control problems, and self-paternalistic interventions (hard constraints on oneself that do not curb others' liberty); online environments' manipulative properties can be harnessed for self-control.
CORE-08.ess: not_quantifiable: qualitative/theoretical with illustrative case studies (organic food-box scheme, browser defaults, greyscale, ad blockers); the paper itself disclaims its examples ('illustrations rather than evidence-based policy interventions, as they have not been subjected to empirical testing').
CORE-08.lim: Examples explicitly untested (source's own disclaimer); 'autonomy enhancement' is definitional/normative, not empirically demonstrated (no experiment compares self-nudging vs nudging on autonomy or adherence); self-nudging presupposes self-knowledge, behavioral/digital literacy, and environment malleability (equity risk for low-literacy/low-malleability users); voluntary self-control strategies show low adherence/mixed results (e.g., Dansinger et al. 2005 cited in-article); boundary between self-nudge and self-paternalism ethically underexplored; not sufficient for deep addiction/compulsion.
CORE-08.di: If people systematically fail to anticipate their own future behavior (meta-level present bias), self-nudges will be under-deployed or mis-designed; if environments are not malleable, self-nudging is unavailable; self-nudging could entrench an individual-responsibility narrative that shifts blame from harmful environments to individuals (moral-hollowing risk); strong habits resist choice-architecture fixes.
CORE-08.dimpl: Central mechanism for authorship (lambda; M4d) - Self-Nudging Design Card: enable the user to redesign their own choice architecture (defaults, notification regimes, friction, positioning) rather than only being nudged. lambda must be structural/presence-based (did the user author or redesign their own choice architecture? 0/1 or ordinal), NOT a calibrated scalar - the source provides no quantitative basis; pilot uses SCED logic (baseline -> self-nudge phase -> follow-up) with descriptive reporting; measure enactment and acceptance, not just engagement.
CORE-08.cimpl: Self-authorship is a vehicle for autonomy but not sufficient: the user's proximate choice architecture is a technical milieu the user must be able to revise (locality, S10) rather than an imposed identity (localism). 'Not sufficient' is retained as a structural guard against the individual-responsibility collapse and to keep authorship phenomenological rather than a self-management score.

A1-01.kft: Technology is not anthropologically universal; 'cosmotechnics' names the unification of cosmos (cosmological order), morality (ethical order), and technics (technical order) - 'scientific and technical thinking emerges under cosmological conditions expressed in the relations between humans and their milieus, which are never static' (verified from the archive scan, PDF p.37 ~ print pp.18-19; page numbering differs between scan and Urbanomic print edition); the question concerning technology in China cannot be answered by importing Heidegger's Occidental framework (impasse); urgent need for a Chinese philosophy of technology that pluralizes technics and counters blind modernization while avoiding culturalist nostalgia; critique of Leroi-Gourhan (technical genealogy misses cosmological conditions) and Gille (Western-centric technical systems).
A1-01.ess: not_quantifiable (philosophical). Strength = high as the governing cosmotechnic criterion source (a construct-role claim, not evidence strength).
A1-01.lim: Single-author constructive essay/book; programmatic argument with normative agenda; selective engagement with Chinese intellectual history (read through Heidegger/Needham/Simondon/Stiegler); archive.org scan is a rights-caution copy (shared non-lending collection item; uploader rights unverified) - prefer publisher/licensed text for formal quoting; edition/page-number variance between scan and print; 'cosmotechnic pluralism' is a thesis, not an established descriptive fact.
A1-01.di: If technics are ultimately universalizable (functional convergence), cosmotechnic pluralism overstates divergence; if 'cosmotechnics' itself operates with Western categories, the critique of dependency is incomplete (an internal challenge Hui anticipates); historical technology shows massive cross-cultural borrowing, complicating civilizational distinctness claims.
A1-01.dimpl: Governing telos (layer 2.13) - the plan's horizon: the tool must be grounded in a cosmos-ethic-technics unity, not output maximization; any artifact claim must be checkable against the cosmotechnic criterion.
A1-01.cimpl: Sets the whole cosmotechnic criterion; anti-veneer standard - 'cosmotechnics' must remain structural, never decorative. (No revision: correct and meta-level.)

HUI-2024.kft: Third and final volume of the Recursivity & Contingency series (after Art and Cosmotechnics 2021); a 'Tractatus Politico-Technologicus': political philosophy can no longer avoid technology; introduces 'political epistemology' as the method (following Mumford's megamachine - political epistemology legitimates and guides it); engages Hegel's nation-state and Schmitt's Grossraum as the two modern political forms a future planetary thinking must surpass; core agenda: technodiversity (biodiversity-noodiversity-technodiversity), an organology of wars, the Nomos of the Digital Earth, digital sovereignty, the prosthetic future critique (acceleration/automation; exosomatization framing: the human is 'largely dependent on exosomatization' and 'the question of morality should be considered from an exosomatic point of view', print p.99), epistemological diplomacy, locality without localism.
HUI-2024.ess: not_quantifiable (philosophical). Strength = high as the v6 scaffold/anti-veneer standard (construct-role claim).
HUI-2024.lim: Programmatic and speculative; architectonic rather than empirically demonstrated; dense Hegel/Schmitt exegesis; single-author; open-access UMN 2024 edition verified (local copy /opt/data/machine and sovereignty yuk hui.pdf, 352p; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0); audit criteria (technodiversity, organology/proportion, prosthesis vs replacement) require operationalization before use in the Cosmotechnic Audit Card - unoperationalized they risk category error (normative heuristic treated as measurable construct).
HUI-2024.di: If nation-state and Grossraum are not the binding constraints on contemporary digital power (platform/network sovereignty differs from territorial), the planetary framing may miss emergent forms; if technodiversity is read as valorizing any difference (relativism), the anti-localism guard weakens; acceleration/automation may outpace organological critique; if planetary thinking remains a European project in disguise, its universality claim is strained.
HUI-2024.dimpl: Govern cosmotechnic criteria: technodiversity, organology/proportion, prosthesis vs replacement, locality/localism - Cosmotechnic Audit Card / Design Memo v6; operationalize each criterion before use.
HUI-2024.cimpl: Primary v6 cosmotechnic scaffold and anti-veneer standard; the tool must remain a locality capable of revision, not a localism hardened into identity (S10). (No revision: matches the source agenda cleanly.)
